title: Traditional Ukrainian Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole inspired by Ukrainian cuisine, made with tender beef, rich sauce, and a crispy crust.
instructions: Cook the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and grated carrots to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the canned diced tomatoes, mirin, salt, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked ground beef mixture, beaten egg, and pan-fried breadcrumbs.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
